text:
tanisha: Heads-up — we need to reshuffle the release train for tomorrow's window. Two late PRs landed; asking for volunteers to take the late slot (18:00 UTC). Who can own deploy + smoke? TL;DR: need canary 10% -> 50%, DB migration check, rollback plan.

mina: I can take the micro-batching PR (#4821). 18:00 UTC works. I'll be the deploy owner and smoke lead. Will coordinate with SRE for rollback hooks. :thumbsup:

sam: Quick Q — does that require the infra mempool change? If so we should only do canary to start. I can be on standby for infra rollback.

mina: It depends. I tested locally without mempool flip; it passes. No infra change required in this PR. Canary only is fine.

jordan: Note: the analytics DB migration in PR #4799 is going in the same train (timing might overlap). If both land in same window we need serial deploys. Preferable ordering: batching first, then analytics migration. Migration needs preflight snapshot and <2 min lock.

tanisha: Agreed. Plan: 18:00 UTC — mina deploys batching (canary 10% -> 30 -> 80), smoke @ 18:10. 18:25 — jordan runs migration in maintenance mode. lee will run health checks. If any smoke fails, rollback to previous image and abort migration. OK?

lee: Oncall green. I'll run the smoke checklist: 1) /health 2) p95 token latency < 200ms 3) batch success rate > 99% 4) KV cache hit rate stable. I'll be watching for memory regressions. Share runbook link pls.

deploy-bot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-train. Canary rollout automations available: `/deploy --canary=10 --step=20` (internal tool).

mina: Smoke commands I'll run:
```
curl -sS https://staging.redwood/api/health
python infra/tests/smoke_batching.py --samples 500
```
If any errors, I'll `./rollback.sh` and ping #eng-sre.

sam: I'll be on Zoom 17:50-18:40. Ping me @sam if we need infra rollback.

tanisha: Final call: mina owner, jordan migration owner, lee smoke. I'll document timeline in the release calendar and set the Slack reminder `@here 17:50 deploy check-in`. :calendar:

mina: Got it. I'll post smoke outputs here as short snips.

lee: +1. Will set debug logging hooks and retention. :eyes:

tanisha: Thanks team — tagging the release notes PR and linking the canary run config: https://github.com/redwood/release-train/PR-123

mina: Posting canary update: 18:05 canary 10% passed; moving to 30% at 18:07.

lee: 18:09 smoke: /health ok, p95 145ms, batch success 99.6% — proceeding.

jordan: 18:24 migration preflight snapshot done. Ready to run at 18:25.

mina: 18:30 migration complete, no lock over 30s. Release train done. I'll send a brief changelog in #general.

tanisha: Excellent — closing. If any follow-ups, open a postmortem thread with the prefix `deploy-followup:`. :tada:
